units.en: Xuanzhen submitted a petition stating, "In the twelfth month of the third year of Kaicheng, with funds provided by Military Governor Lu Jun of Lingnan from his salary, grieving that my family's coffins from three generations lie exposed in different places, I have arranged for them to be brought home for burial in the ancestral tomb.
units.literal: Xuanzhen submitted a petition stating, "Within the twelfth month of the third year of Kaicheng, receiving support from Military Governor Lu Jun of Lingnan from his salary funds, grieving that my family's three generations of traveling coffins lie exposed, each in a different place, I specially arranged their dispatch to return to the great tomb for joint burial.

units.zh: 今護四喪，已到長樂旅店權下，未委故越王墳所在，伏乞天恩，允妾所奏，許歸大塋。
units.en: I am now escorting four coffins and have temporarily lodged at an inn at Changle; I do not know where the tomb of the former Prince of Yue lies; I humbly beg Your Majesty to grant my petition and permit burial in the ancestral tomb.
units.literal: Now escorting four coffins, I have reached a Changle inn and lodged there temporarily; I do not know the location of the former Prince of Yue's tomb; I humbly beg Heaven's grace to grant my petition and permit return to the great tomb.

units.zh: 妾年已六十三，孤露家貧，更無依倚。」
units.en: I am sixty-three years old, orphaned and destitute, with no one left to rely upon."
units.literal: I am already sixty-three, orphaned and exposed, my household poor, with no further support."

units.zh: 詔曰：「越王事跡，國史著明，枉陷非辜，尋已洗雪。
units.en: An edict stated, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic histories; wrongly implicated without guilt, his name was long since cleared.
units.literal: An edict stated, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic history; wrongly implicated without guilt, his name was soon cleared.

units.zh: 其珍子他事配流，數代漂零，不還京國。
units.en: Zhenzi was banished for another offense; for generations the family drifted in exile, never returning to the capital.
units.literal: Zhenzi was banished for another affair; for generations they drifted in exile, not returning to the capital.

units.zh: 玄真弱女，孝節卓然，啟護四喪，綿歷萬里；
units.en: Xuanzhen, a frail woman, displays outstanding filial devotion, escorting four coffins across ten thousand li;
units.literal: Xuanzhen, a frail woman, displays outstanding filial constancy, undertaking to escort four coffins across ten thousand li;

units.zh: 況是近族，必可加恩。
units.en: moreover, as near kin, she surely deserves special favor.
units.literal: moreover as near kin, favor must surely be extended.

units.zh: 行路猶或嗟稱，朝廷固須恤助。
units.en: Travelers on the road still sigh in admiration; the court must show compassion and aid.
units.literal: Travelers on the road still sigh in praise; the court must certainly show compassion and aid.

units.zh: 委宗正寺、京兆府與訪越王墳墓報知。
units.en: Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and the Metropolitan Prefecture to locate the Prince of Yue's tomb and report back.
units.literal: Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and the Metropolitan Prefecture to seek out the Prince of Yue's tomb and report.

units.zh: 如不是陪陵，任祔塋次卜葬。
units.en: If it is not an attendant tomb, permit burial in the secondary plot as divination directs.
units.literal: If it is not an attendant tomb, permit burial in the secondary plot according to divination.

units.zh: 其葬事仍令京兆府接措，必使備禮。
units.en: The Metropolitan Prefecture shall handle the burial and ensure full ceremony.
units.literal: The burial affairs shall still be handled by the Metropolitan Prefecture, ensuring full ritual.

units.zh: 葬畢，玄真如願住京城，便配咸宜觀安置。」
units.en: When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to remain in the capital, assign her residence at Xianyi Abbey."
units.literal: When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to dwell in the capital, assign her residence at Xianyi Abbey."

units.zh: 孝女王和子者，徐州人。
units.en: The filial daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xu Prefecture.
units.literal: The filial daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 其父及兄為防秋卒，戍涇州。
units.en: Her father and elder brother were frontier-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jing Prefecture.
units.literal: Her father and elder brother were autumn-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jingzhou.

units.zh: 元和中，吐蕃寇邊，父兄戰死，無子，母先亡。
units.en: During the Yuanhe reign the Tibetans raided the frontier; her father and brother died in battle; there were no sons; her mother had died earlier.
units.literal: During the Yuanhe era the Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle; there were no sons; her mother had died earlier.

units.zh: 和子時年十七，聞父兄歿於邊上，被髮徒跣缞裳，獨往涇州。
units.en: Hezi was seventeen; hearing that her father and brother had died on the frontier, she went alone to Jing Prefecture with hair unbound, barefoot, in mourning garments.
units.literal: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound and barefoot in mourning garments she went alone to Jingzhou.

units.zh: 行丐取父兄之喪，歸徐營葬。
units.en: Begging along the way, she retrieved her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu Prefecture, and gave them proper burial.
units.literal: Traveling as a beggar she retrieved her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu, and arranged burial.

units.zh: 手植松柏，剪發壞形，廬於墓所。
units.en: She planted pine and cypress with her own hands, cut her hair and disfigured her appearance, and lived in a mourning hut beside the tomb.
units.literal: She planted pine and cypress with her own hands, cut her hair and disfigured her form, and dwelt in a hut at the tomb.

units.zh: 節度使王智興以狀聞，詔旌表之。
units.en: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported her deeds, and an edict honored her household.
units.literal: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the circumstances and an edict honored her household.

units.zh: 又大中五年，兗州瑕丘縣人鄭神佐女，年二十四，先許適馳雄牙官李玄慶。
units.en: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yan Prefecture, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.
units.literal: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yanzhou, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.

units.zh: 神佐亦為官健，戍慶州。
units.en: Shenzuo also served as a government soldier garrisoned at Qing Prefecture.
units.literal: Shenzuo also served as a government soldier garrisoned at Qingzhou.

units.zh: 時党項叛，神佐戰死，其母先亡，無子。
units.en: When the Tangut rebelled, Shenzuo died in battle; his mother had died earlier, and there were no sons.
units.literal: At the time the Tangut rebelled; Shenzuo died in battle; his mother had died earlier; there were no sons.

units.zh: 女以父戰歿邊城，無由得還，乃剪發壞形，自往慶州護父喪還，至瑕丘縣進賢鄉馬青村，與母合葬。
units.en: Because her father had died in battle at a distant fortress with no means of bringing his body home, the daughter cut her hair and disfigured her appearance, traveled alone to Qing Prefecture to escort her father's remains home, and buried him beside her mother in Maqing Village, Jinxian Township, Xiqiu County.
units.literal: The daughter, because her father had died in battle at the border fortress with no means of return, cut her hair and disfigured her form, went herself to Qingzhou to escort her father's remains home, reaching Maqing Village in Jinxian Township of Xiqiu County, and buried him together with her mother.

units.zh: 便廬於墳所，手植松檜，誓不適人。
units.en: She then lived in a mourning hut beside the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and vowed never to marry.
units.literal: She then dwelt in a hut at the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and vowed never to marry.

units.zh: 節度使蕭椒以狀奏之曰：「伏以閭裏之中，罕知禮教，女子之性，尤昧義方。
units.en: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized, "I humbly observe that in village neighborhoods, ritual instruction is rarely known, and women especially lack understanding of righteousness.
units.literal: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized in a report, "I humbly observe that among village neighborhoods, ritual instruction is rarely known; the nature of women especially lacks understanding of righteousness.

units.zh: 鄭氏女痛結窮泉，哀深《陟岵》，投身沙磧，歸父遺骸，遠自邊陲，得還閭裏。
units.en: The daughter of the Zheng clan, her grief reaching to the underworld, her sorrow as deep as the 'Ascending the Mound,' braved the desert wastes to bring her father's remains home from the distant frontier to her native village.
units.literal: The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep springs, sorrow deep as the 'Ascending the Mound,' cast herself into sandy wastes to return her father's remains, coming from far borderlands back to her native village.

units.zh: 感《蓼莪》以積恨，守丘墓以誓心。
units.en: Moved by the 'Polygala,' she nursed bitter grief; guarding the tomb mound, she pledged her heart.
units.literal: Moved by the 'Polygala' she accumulated bitter grief; guarding the mound and tomb she pledged her heart.

units.zh: 克彰孝理之仁，足厲貞方之節。」
units.en: She fully displayed the benevolence of filial devotion and amply exemplified the constancy of chaste conduct."
units.literal: She fully displayed the benevolence of filial principle and sufficiently inspired the constancy of chaste conduct."

units.zh: 詔旌表門閭。
units.en: An edict honored her household.
units.literal: An edict honored her household gate.

units.zh: 贊曰：政教隆平，男忠女貞。
units.en: The encomium states: When government and instruction flourish in peace, men are loyal and women constant.
units.literal: The encomium states: When government and instruction flourish in peace, men are loyal and women chaste.

units.zh: 禮以自防，義不茍生。
units.en: Through ritual they guard themselves; through righteousness they refuse to live in shame.
units.literal: Through ritual they guard themselves; through righteousness they do not cling to life in degradation.

units.zh: 彤管有煒，蘭閨振聲。
units.en: The historian's red brush shines bright; women's chambers resound with fame.
units.literal: The red brush shines bright; orchid chambers resound with fame.

units.zh: 《關雎》合《雅》，始號文明。
units.en: When 'Guan Ju' harmonizes with the 'Ya' hymns, civilization is first proclaimed.
units.literal: When 'Guan Ju' harmonizes with the 'Ya' hymns, civilization is first proclaimed.

units.zh: 河間王弘
units.en: Yang Hong, Prince of Hejian
units.literal: Hejian Wang Hong

units.zh: 河間王弘，字辟惡，高祖從祖弟也。
units.en: Yang Hong, Prince of Hejian, courtesy name Bie'e, was a cousin of Emperor Wen on the paternal line.
units.literal: Hejian Wang Hong, styled Bie'e, was a younger paternal-line cousin of Gaozu.

units.zh: 其年立弘為河間王，拜右衛大將軍。
units.en: That year Hong was created Prince of Hejian and appointed General-in-Chief of the Right Guard.
units.literal: That same year Hong was installed as Prince of Hejian and appointed General-in-Chief of the Right Guard.

units.zh: 大業六年，追封郇王。
units.en: In the sixth year of Daye (610), he was posthumously created Prince of Xun.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Daye, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xun.

units.zh: 及上受禪，拜大將軍，進爵郡公。
units.en: When Yang Jian ascended the throne, Hong was made Grand General and promoted to Duke of a Commandery.
units.literal: When the emperor accepted the abdication, he was appointed Grand General and advanced in rank to Duke of a Commandery.

units.zh: 賜物二千段，出拜甯州總管，進位上柱國。
units.en: Rewarded with two thousand bales of textiles, he was appointed Director-General of Ning Province and promoted to First Rank Pillar of State.
units.literal: He was granted two thousand bales of goods, was sent out as Director-General of Ning Province, and advanced to First Rank Pillar of State.

units.zh: 未幾，拜蒲州刺史，得以便宜從事。
units.en: Not long afterward he was made governor of Pu Prefecture with authority to act at his own discretion.
units.literal: Before long he was appointed governor of Pu Prefecture and granted discretion to act as circumstances required.

units.zh: 時突厥屢為邊患，以行軍元帥率眾數萬，出靈州道，與虜相遇，戰，大破之，斬數千級。
units.en: When the Turks were repeatedly raiding the frontier, he served as commander of the field army at the head of tens of thousands of men. Marching out along the Lingzhou route, he met the enemy in battle and routed them, beheading several thousand.
units.literal: At the time the Turks were a repeated menace on the frontier; as commander of the field army he led a force of tens of thousands by the Lingzhou route, encountered the barbarians, fought, and utterly defeated them, taking several thousand heads.

units.zh: 父元孫，少孤，隨母郭氏養于舅族。
units.en: His father Yuansun lost his parents in childhood and was brought up by his mother, Lady Guo, among her maternal relatives.
units.literal: His father Yuansun, orphaned in youth, was raised by his mother Lady Guo among her maternal clan.

units.zh: 祖愛敬，早卒。
units.en: His grandfather Aijing died at an early age.
units.literal: His grandfather Aijing died young.

units.zh: （子慶）
units.en: (His son Qing)
units.literal: (His son Qing)

units.zh: 子慶嗣。
units.en: His son Qing inherited his title.
units.literal: His son Qing succeeded him.

units.zh: 其嫡母元太妃，年老，兩目失明，王世充以慶叛己而斬之。
units.en: His stepmother, Grand Consort Yuan, was elderly and blind in both eyes. Wang Shichong had her executed when Qing defected.
units.literal: His principal mother, Grand Consort Yuan, was elderly and blind in both eyes; Wang Shichong had her executed because Qing had betrayed him.

units.zh: 歲餘，進授柱國。
units.en: A little over a year later he was promoted to Pillar of State.
units.literal: After more than a year, he was advanced to Pillar of State.

units.zh: 煬帝嗣位，征還，拜太子太保。
units.en: When Emperor Yang came to the throne, Hong was recalled and made Grand Mentor to the crown prince.
units.literal: When Emperor Yang succeeded to the throne, Hong was recalled and appointed Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 歲餘，薨。
units.en: A little over a year later he died.
units.literal: After more than a year, he died.

units.zh: 高祖詣周趙王宅，將及於難，弘時立於戶外，以衛高祖。
units.en: On the occasion when Yang Jian visited the residence of Zhao, Prince of Zhou, and nearly came to harm, Hong stood guard outside the door to protect him.
units.literal: When Gaozu went to the residence of Zhao, Prince of Zhou, and was about to meet with disaster, Hong stood outside the door at the time to guard Gaozu.

units.zh: 弘在州，治尚清靜，甚有恩惠。
units.en: As provincial governor he favored a light, unobtrusive administration and was widely regarded as a benevolent ruler.
units.literal: In his province, Hong's governance valued quiet simplicity, and he showed much kindness and grace.

units.zh: 弘奏為盜者百餘人，投之邊裔，州境帖然，號為良吏。
units.en: Hong identified more than a hundred robbers and had them sent to the frontier. With the territory at peace, he won renown as an outstanding official.
units.literal: Hong petitioned regarding more than a hundred robbers, exiling them to the frontier regions; the territory of the prefecture became calm, and he was acclaimed as a good official.

units.zh: 元孫死，齊為周所並，弘始入關，與高祖相得。
units.en: After Yuansun died and Qi was overrun by Zhou, Hong finally entered Guanzhong, where he and the future Emperor Wen became close.
units.literal: Yuansun died; when Qi was absorbed by Zhou, Hong first entered the passes and found favor with Gaozu.

units.zh: 弘性明悟，有文武幹略。
units.en: Hong was quick-witted by nature and possessed both literary and military ability.
units.literal: Hong was bright and perceptive by nature, with both civil and military talent and resourcefulness.

units.zh: 高祖為丞相，常置左右，委以心腹。
units.en: While still serving as chancellor, Yang Jian kept Hong close at hand and treated him as one of his most trusted inner circle.
units.literal: When Gaozu was chancellor, he was kept constantly at his side and entrusted as an intimate confidant.

units.zh: 每晉王廣入朝，弘輒領揚州總管，及晉王歸籓，弘複還蒲州。
units.en: Whenever Prince Guang of Jin visited the capital, Hong would temporarily serve as Director-General of Yang Province; when the prince returned to his fief, Hong would go back to Pu.
units.literal: Whenever Prince Jin Guang came to court for an audience, Hong would take charge as Director-General of Yang Province; when the Prince of Jin returned to his fief, Hong would resume his post at Pu.

units.zh: 史臣曰：高祖始遷周鼎，眾心未附，利建同姓，維城宗社，是以河間、觀德，咸啟山河。
units.en: The historiographer writes: When Emperor Wen first seized the Mandate, loyalties were still unsettled. He enfeoffed men of the Yang clan to buttress the throne—thus the princes of Hejian and Guande were both granted domains spanning mountains and rivers.
units.literal: The historiographers say: When Gaozu first moved the tripod of Zhou, hearts were not yet attached; enfeoffing those of the same surname to protect the altars of state was advantageous—therefore Hejian and Guande both opened territories across mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 及用嚴綬為招討，為賊所敗，弘方鎮汴州，當兩河賊之沖要，朝廷慮其異志，欲以兵柄授之，而令李光顏、烏重胤實當旗鼓。
units.en: When Yan Shou was appointed campaign commander and defeated, Hong still held Bianzhou at the strategic junction of the two He rebels; the court feared disloyalty and wished to give him nominal command while Li Guangyan and Wu Chongyin led the actual fighting.
units.literal: When Yan Shou was used as campaign commander and was defeated by the rebels, Hong was then governing Bian Prefecture at the strategic choke point of the two He bandits; the court feared his divergent intentions, wished to grant him the military command, yet had Li Guangyan and Wu Chongyin actually bear the banners and drums.

units.zh: 吳元濟誅，以統帥功，加檢校司徒、兼侍中，封許國公，罷行營都統。
units.en: When Wu Yuanji was executed, Hong was promoted to acting Minister of Education and palace attendant, enfeoffed as Duke of Xu, and relieved of campaign command.
units.literal: When Wu Yuanji was executed, for his merit as overall commander he was made Acting Minister of Education, concurrently Palace Attendant, enfeoffed as Duke of Xu, and relieved of the campaign command.

units.zh: 衡方厚妻程氏。
units.en: Heng Fanghou's wife, Lady Cheng.
units.literal: The wife of Heng Fanghou, née Cheng.

units.zh: 方厚，太和中任邕州都督府錄事參軍，為招討使董昌齡誣枉殺之。
units.en: Fanghou, in the Taihe era served as Recorder of the Yongzhou Area Command; he was falsely accused and killed by Pacification Commissioner Dong Changling.
units.literal: Fanghou, in the Taihe era served as Recorder of Yongzhou Regional Commandery; he was falsely accused and killed by Pacification Commissioner Dong Changling.

units.zh: 弘實不離理所，唯令其子公武率師三千隸李光顏軍。
units.en: Hong in fact never left his headquarters, sending only his son Gongwu with three thousand men to serve under Li Guangyan.
units.literal: Hong in fact did not leave his headquarters; he only ordered his son Gongwu to lead three thousand troops subordinate to Li Guangyan's army.

units.zh: 時酷吏周興、來俊臣、丘神勣、王弘義等構陷無辜，皆抵極法，公卿震恐，莫敢正言。
units.en: Cruel officials such as Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, Qiu Shenji, and Wang Hongyi framed the innocent to extreme punishments while the court fell silent.
units.literal: At the time the cruel officials Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, Qiu Shenji, Wang Hongyi, and others framed the innocent; all reached extreme law; dukes and ministers trembled in fear and none dared speak straight.

units.zh: 俊臣、張知默等又抗表請申大法，則天不許之。
units.en: Lai Junchen and Zhang Zhimou protested for harsh law, but she refused.
units.literal: Junchen, Zhang Zhimou, and others again submitted memorials requesting application of the great law; Wu Zetian did not permit it.

units.zh: 俊臣乃獨引行本，重驗前罪，奏曰：“行本潛行悖逆，告張知蹇與廬陵王反不實，罪當處斬。”
units.en: Junchen alone brought Xingben back, re-examined the case, and said Xingben had falsely reported the Prince of Luling's rebellion and deserved death.
units.literal: Junchen then alone led out Xingben, again verified the former crime, and submitted: "Xingben secretly acted in rebellion, reporting to Zhang Zhijian that the Prince of Luling's rebellion was untrue—the crime should be execution."

units.zh: 有功駁奏曰：“俊臣乖明主再生之賜，虧聖人恩信之道。
units.en: Yougong rebutted: "Junchen defies your gift of life and betrays imperial grace.
units.literal: Yougong rebutted the memorial, saying: "Junchen violates the enlightened ruler's gift of renewed life and damages the sage's path of grace and trust.

units.zh: 周興、來俊臣等性惟殘酷，務在誅夷，不順其情，立加誣害。
units.en: Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, and their ilk were cruel by nature, bent on slaughter, and would fabricate charges without regard to truth.
units.literal: Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, and others by nature were only cruel; they strove to exterminate and slay; not following the facts, they immediately added false harm.

units.zh: 及王師逼郾城，昌齡乃以城降，且說賊將鄧懷金歸款於李光顏。
units.en: When the imperial army pressed Yancheng, Changling surrendered the city and persuaded the rebel general Deng Huaijin to submit to Li Guangyan.
units.literal: When the imperial army pressed Yancheng, Changling then surrendered the city and also persuaded the rebel general Deng Huaijin to submit to Li Guangyan.

units.zh: 董昌齡母楊氏。
units.en: Yang Shi, mother of Dong Changling.
units.literal: Yang Shi, mother of Dong Changling.

units.zh: 昌齡常為泗州長史，世居於蔡。
units.en: Changling had been Chief Administrator of Si Prefecture and his family had dwelt in Cai for generations.
units.literal: Changling often served as Chief Administrator of Sizhou and for generations dwelt in Cai.

units.zh: 昌齡志未果，元濟又署為郾城令。
units.en: Changling's resolve was not yet firm; Yuanji again appointed him Magistrate of Yancheng.
units.literal: Changling's resolve was not yet fulfilled; Yuanji again appointed him Magistrate of Yancheng.

units.zh: 憲宗聞之喜，急召昌齡至闕，直授郾城令、兼監察御史，仍賜緋魚。
units.en: Xianzong heard with joy and urgently summoned Changling to court, directly appointing him Magistrate of Yancheng and concurrent Investigating Censor, and granting the scarlet robe and fish tally.
units.literal: Xianzong heard with joy and urgently summoned Changling to court, directly appointing him Magistrate of Yancheng and Acting Investigating Censor, also granting the scarlet robe and fish tally.

units.zh: 昌齡泣謝曰：「此皆老母之訓。」
units.en: Changling wept and thanked him, "This is all my old mother's instruction."
units.literal: Changling wept and thanked him: "This is all my old mother's instruction."

units.zh: 昌齡雅不疑慮，聽其歸葬。
units.en: Changling, unsuspecting, allowed her to return and bury him.
units.literal: Changling in his usual manner did not suspect; he allowed her to return and bury him.

units.zh: 御史臺鞫之，得實，諫官亦有章疏，故昌齡再受譴逐。
units.en: The Censorate investigated and confirmed the facts; remonstrance officials also submitted memorials, and Changling was again demoted and expelled.
units.literal: The Censorate investigated and found the facts; remonstrance officials also submitted memorials, so Changling was again demoted and expelled.

units.zh: 累事吳少誠、少陽，至元濟時，為吳房令。
units.en: He served Wu Shaocheng and Shaoyang in succession; by Wu Yuanji's time he was Magistrate of Wufang.
units.literal: He served Wu Shaocheng and Shaoyang in succession; by Yuanji's time he was Magistrate of Wufang.

units.zh: 少孤，受訓於母。
units.en: Orphaned young, he was instructed by his mother.
units.literal: Orphaned young, he received instruction from his mother.

units.zh: 節度使蕭椒以狀奏之曰：「伏以閭里之中，罕知禮教，女子之性，尤昧義方。
units.en: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized, "Within villages and lanes ritual teaching is rarely known; the nature of women is especially ignorant of righteousness.
units.literal: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized: "I submit that within villages and lanes ritual teaching is rarely known; the nature of women is especially ignorant of righteousness.

units.zh: 又大中五年，兗州瑕丘縣人鄭神佐女，年二十四，先許適馳雄牙官李玄慶。
units.en: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yan Prefecture, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.
units.literal: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yanzhou, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.

units.zh: 鄭氏女痛結窮泉，哀深《陟岵》，投身沙磧，歸父遺骸，遠自邊陲，得還閭里。
units.en: The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep spring, sorrow deep as in 'Ascending the Knoll'—she threw herself into sandy wastes, recovered her father's remains, and returned from the distant border to her native village."
units.literal: The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep spring, sorrow deep as in 'Ascending the Knoll'—she threw herself into sandy wastes, recovered her father's remains, far from the border marches returning to her native lane."

units.zh: 感《蓼莪》以積恨，守丘墓以誓心。
units.en: Moved by 'The Smartweed' she accumulated resentment; she guarded the tomb to pledge her heart."
units.literal: Moved by 'The Smartweed' she accumulated resentment; she guarded the mound and tomb to pledge her heart."

units.zh: 克彰孝理之仁，足厲貞方之節。」
units.en: She displayed the benevolence of filial principle and fully inspired the integrity of chaste conduct."
units.literal: She was able to display the benevolence of filial principle and fully inspire the integrity of chaste conduct."

units.zh: 太廟配饗功臣，高祖室加裴寂、劉文靜，太宗室加長孫無忌、李靖、杜如晦，高宗室加褚遂良、高季輔、劉仁軌，中宗室加狄仁傑、魏元忠、王同皎等十一人。
units.en: Meritorious ministers associated in feasting at the Grand Temple: to Gaozu's chamber added Pei Ji and Liu Wenjing; to Taizong's chamber added Zhangsun Wuji, Li Jing, and Du Ruhui; to Gaozong's chamber added Chu Suiliang, Gao Jifu, and Liu Rengui; to Zhongzong's chamber added Di Renjie, Wei Yuanzhong, Wang Tongjiao, and eleven others.
units.literal: As to meritorious ministers associated in feasting at the Grand Temple: to Gaozu's chamber added Pei Ji and Liu Wenjing; to Taizong's chamber added Zhangsun Wuji, Li Jing, and Du Ruhui; to Gaozong's chamber added Chu Suiliang, Gao Jifu, and Liu Rengui; to Zhongzong's chamber added Di Renjie, Wei Yuanzhong, Wang Tongjiao, and eleven others.

units.zh: 楊紹宗妻王氏，華州華陰人也。
units.en: Wang Shi, wife of Yang Shaozong, was a native of Huayin in Hua Prefecture.
units.literal: Wang Shi, wife of Yang Shaozong—Wang Shi was a native of Huayin in Huazhou.

units.zh: 永徽中，詔曰：「故楊紹宗妻王氏，因心為孝，率性成道。
units.en: During the Yonghui reign an edict said, "The late Yang Shaozong's wife Wang Shi, filial in heart and steadfast in nature.
units.literal: During the Yonghui era an edict said: "The late Yang Shaozong's wife Wang Shi, with her heart made filial and her nature formed in the Way.

units.zh: 又有尉氏尉王泛妻裴氏，儀王傅巨卿之女也。
units.en: There was also Pei Shi, wife of Wang Fan, Magistrate of Weishi, daughter of Juqing, Tutor to the Prince of Yi.
units.literal: There was also Pei Shi, wife of Wang Fan, Magistrate of Weishi—daughter of Juqing, Tutor to the Prince of Yi.

units.zh: 宣州觀察使殷日用奏為判官，宣慰使李季卿又以表薦，連授大理評事、兼監察御史。
units.en: Yin Riyong, commissioner observing Xuanzhou, memorialized to make him judge; pacification commissioner Li Jiqing also recommended him, and he was successively made evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review and concurrent investigating censor.
units.literal: Yin Riyong, observation commissioner of Xuanzhou, memorialized to appoint him judge; the pacification commissioner Li Jiqing also recommended him by memorial, and he was successively made Evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review and concurrent Investigating Censor.

units.zh: 適延壽公於欽明子敏直。
units.en: She married Yu Minzhi, son of Qinming, Duke of Yanshou.
units.literal: She married Minzhi, son of Qinming, Duke of Yanshou.

units.zh: 高宗下詔，賜物百段，仍令史官錄之。
units.en: Emperor Gaozong issued an edict granting her a hundred lengths of goods and ordered the historians to record her deed.
units.literal: Gaozong issued an edict granting her a hundred lengths of goods and ordering the historiographers to record it.

units.zh: 梁鸿字伯鸾，扶风平陵人也。
units.en: Liang Hong, styled Boluan, was from Pingling in Fufeng.
units.literal: Liang Hong, courtesy name Boluan, was a man of Pingling in Fufeng.

units.zh: 乃易姓运期，名耀，字侯光，与妻子居齐鲁之间。
units.en: He therefore changed his surname to Yunqi, his personal name to Yao, and his courtesy name to Houguang, and hid with his wife between Qi and Lu.
units.literal: He therefore changed his surname to Yunqi, his name to Yao, his courtesy name to Houguang, and dwelt with his wife between Qi and Lu.

units.zh: 乃共入霸陵山中，以耕织为业，咏《诗》、《书》，弹琴以自娱。
units.en: Together they fled to Mount Baling, farmed and wove, chanted the Odes and Documents, and played the zither for joy.
units.literal: Thereupon together they entered Mount Baling, took plowing and weaving as their occupation, chanted the Poetry and Documents, and played the zither to amuse themselves.

units.zh: 仰慕前世高士，而为四皓以来二十四人作颂。
units.en: He honored ancient recluses and wrote hymns for twenty-four worthies from the Four Hoaryheads onward.
units.literal: He admired the high gentlemen of former ages and therefore composed encomia for twenty-four men from the Four Elders onward.

units.zh: 鴻潛閉著書十餘篇。
units.en: Liang Hong shut himself in and wrote a dozen essays.
units.literal: Hong hid away and closed his door, composing more than ten pieces of writing.

units.zh: 后受业太学，家贫而尚节介，博览无不通，而不为章句。
units.en: Later he studied at the Imperial Academy—poor but principled, widely read, scorning pedantic glosses.
units.literal: Later he received instruction at the Imperial Academy; his family was poor yet he esteemed integrity; he broadly read and there was nothing he did not penetrate, yet he did not do chapter-and-verse analysis.

units.zh: 鸿闻而娉之。
units.en: Liang heard and sent matchmakers.
units.literal: Hong heard and betrothed her.

units.zh: 字之曰德曜，名孟光。
units.en: He gave her the style Deyao—her name was Meng Guang.
units.literal: He styled her Deyao and named her Meng Guang.

units.zh: 疾且困，告主人曰：“昔延陵季子葬子于嬴博之间，不归乡里，慎勿令我子持丧归去。”
units.en: Dying, he told his host, "When Jizi of Yanling buried his son between Ying and Bo he did not send the corpse home—do not let my son haul my bier back to Fufeng."
units.literal: When he was gravely ill and in distress, he told his host, "In antiquity Jizi of Yanling buried his son between Ying and Bo and did not return him to the home village; take care not to let my son bear the mourning back home."

units.zh: 葬毕，妻子归扶风。
units.en: When the rites ended, his family went home to Fufeng.
units.literal: When the burial was finished, wife and children returned to Fufeng.

units.zh: 及卒，伯通等为求葬地于吴要离冢傍。
units.en: At his death Gao and friends buried him beside Yaoli the martyr in Wu.
units.literal: When he died, Botong and others for him sought a burial place beside the tomb of Yaoli in Wu.

units.zh: 初，鸿友人京兆高恢，少好《老子》，隐于华阴山中。
units.en: His friend Gao Hui of Jingzhao, who loved the Laozi in youth, had hidden on Mount Huayin.
units.literal: In the beginning Hong's friend Gao Hui of Jingzhao, in his youth loved the Laozi and concealed himself in the mountains of Huayin.

units.zh: 因东出关，过京师，作《五噫之歌》曰：“陟彼北芒兮，噫！
units.en: East through the passes he passed Luoyang and sang his "Song of Five Sighs": "I climb the northern ridge—ah!
units.literal: Therefore he went east out of the passes, passed the capital, and composed the "Song of Five Sighs," saying, "I climb that northern mound—yi!

units.zh: 顾览帝京兮，噫！
units.en: I turn and gaze on the royal city—ah!
units.literal: I turn and gaze on the imperial capital—yi!

units.zh: 宫室崔嵬兮，噫！
units.en: Palaces rear against the sky—ah!
units.literal: Palace halls tower—yi!

units.zh: 人之劬劳兮，噫！
units.en: The people labor endless—ah!
units.literal: The toil of men—yi!

units.zh: 辽辽未央兮，噫！”
units.en: Boundless, the palace unending—ah!"
units.literal: Vast, vast, not yet ended—yi!"

units.zh: 将行，作诗曰：
units.en: Before leaving he wrote:
units.literal: About to depart, he composed a poem, saying:

units.zh: 逝旧帮兮遐征，将遥集兮东南。
units.en: I quit my homeland for a distant road, bound to roost in the southeast.
units.literal: I leave my old domain on a distant march; I shall aloofly settle in the southeast.

units.zh: 心惙怛兮伤悴，志菲菲兮升降。
units.en: Grief tugs my heart; my purpose flickers high and low.
units.literal: My heart is anxious and wounded; my aims flutter as I rise and fall.

units.zh: 欲乘策兮纵迈，疾吾俗兮作谗。
units.en: I long to ride free, yet loathe a world that trades in malice.
units.literal: I wish to mount the whip and gallop free, yet hate how my folk invent slander.

units.zh: 竞举枉兮措直，咸先佞兮唌々。
units.en: The crooked win office while the upright fall; toadies lead while worthies choke.
units.literal: They vie to raise the crooked and set aside the straight; all put flatterers first and smack their lips.

units.zh: 固靡惭兮独建，冀异州兮尚贤。
units.en: I am not ashamed to stand alone—I trust another land may prize the good.
units.literal: Truly I feel no shame standing alone; I hope in another land they still honor the worthy.

units.zh: 聊逍遥兮遨嬉，缵仲尼兮周流。
units.en: I drift awhile for sport, following Confucius's wide road.
units.literal: For a while I wander and roam, tracing Confucius's circuit round the realm.

units.zh: 倘云睹兮我悦，遂舍车兮即浮。
units.en: If clouds should please me, I will quit the cart and trust myself to the flood.
units.literal: If perchance the clouds should please my eye, I will leave my cart and board a raft at once.

units.zh: 过季札兮延陵，求鲁连兮海隅。
units.en: I call at Jizi's Yanling; I seek Lu Zhonglian on the shore.
units.literal: I pass Jizi at Yanling; I seek Lu Zhonglian by the sea's edge.

units.zh: 虽不察兮光貌，幸神灵兮与休。
units.en: Though I cannot see their faces, the gods at least grant me peace.
units.literal: Though I cannot see their bright faces, happily the spirits grant me rest.

units.zh: 惟季春兮华阜，麦含含兮方秀。
units.en: Late spring on the blooming hill—wheat swelling toward the ear.
units.literal: Only in late spring on the flowering mound, the wheat swelling, just coming into ear.

units.zh: 哀茂时兮逾迈，愍芳香兮日臭。
units.en: I mourn the good years racing by; I pity sweet scent turning stale.
units.literal: I mourn that the lush season hurries past; I pity the fragrance that daily fades.

units.zh: 悼吾心兮不获，长委结兮焉究！
units.en: My heart wins nothing it longs for—this knot—where will it end!
units.literal: I grieve that my heart cannot win its wish; long knotted—where shall it end!

units.zh: 口嚣嚣兮余讪，嗟恇恇兮谁留？
units.en: The crowd mocks my voice; who, trembling, will remain with me?
units.literal: Mouths clamor and mock me; alas, alone, alone—who will stay?

units.zh: 有顷，又去适吴。
units.en: Soon he moved on toward Wu.
units.literal: Before long he again left and went to Wu.

units.zh: 遂至吴，依大家皋伯通，居庑下，为人赁舂。
units.en: He reached Wu, lodged with magnate Gao Botong under the eaves, and earned his keep grinding grain.
units.literal: Thereupon he reached Wu, lodged with the great house of Gao Botong, dwelt beneath the porch gallery, and for people hired out his pestle for grinding.

units.zh: 父让，王莽时为城门校尉，封脩远伯，使奉少昊后，寓于北地而卒。
units.en: His father Liang Rang, under Wang Mang, was colonel of the gates, enfeoffed Baron Xiuyuan to sacrifice to Shaohao, then moved to Beidi and died there.
units.literal: His father Rang, in Wang Mang's time was colonel of the gates, enfeoffed as baron of Xiuyuan, and was sent to continue the line of Shaohao; he lodged in Beidi and died.

units.zh: 肃宗闻而非之，求鸿不得。
units.en: Emperor Zhang heard the song, took offense, and hunted Liang Hong in vain.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhang heard of it he condemned it and sought Hong but could not find him.

units.zh: 鸿时尚幼，以遭乱世，因卷席而葬。
units.en: The boy lived in chaos and buried him with only a mat for coffin.
units.literal: Hong was still young; because he encountered a chaotic age, he therefore rolled up a mat and buried him.

units.zh: 鸿乃寻访烧者，问所去失，悉以豕偿之。
units.en: He tracked every victim, tallied their losses, and paid in pigs.
units.literal: Hong then sought out those burned, asked what they had lost, and fully compensated them with pigs.

units.zh: 鸿曰：“无它财，愿以身居作。”
units.en: Liang said, "I own nothing else—I will work off the debt with my labor."
units.literal: Hong said, "I have no other wealth; I am willing to dwell and work with my body."

units.zh: 邻家耆老见鸿非恒人，乃共责让主人，而称鸿长者。
units.en: Elders saw he was no common laborer, scolded the landlord, and hailed Liang as a gentleman.
units.literal: The old men of the neighboring village saw that Hong was not an ordinary man; they together reproached the master of the house and praised Hong as an elder.

units.zh: 鸿不受而去，归乡里。
units.en: Liang refused the herd and walked home.
units.literal: Hong would not accept but departed and returned to his home village.

units.zh: 势家慕其高节，多欲女之，鸿并绝不娶。
units.en: Great houses courted him with daughters; he turned down every match.
units.literal: Powerful families admired his lofty integrity and for the most part wished to give him their daughters in marriage; Hong one and all refused and would not marry.

units.zh: 女曰：“欲得贤如梁伯鸾者。”
units.en: She said, "I will marry only a worthy like Liang Boluan."
units.literal: The daughter said, "I wish to obtain a worthy like Liang Boluan."

units.zh: 七日而鸿不答。
units.en: Liang spoke not a word to her for seven nights.
units.literal: For seven days Hong did not answer her.

units.zh: 鸿曰：“吾欲裘褐之人，可与俱隐深山者尔。
units.en: Liang answered, "I sought a woman in leather and homespun to vanish with me into the hills.
units.literal: Hong said, "I wanted a person in furs and coarse cloth who could with me hide in the deep mountains—that is all.

units.zh: 鸿大喜曰：“此真梁鸿妻也。
units.en: Liang exulted, "This is the wife of Liang Hong.
units.literal: Hong was greatly pleased and said, "This is truly Liang Hong's wife.

units.zh: 鸿曰：“诺。”
units.en: Liang said, "You are right."
units.literal: Hong said, "Agreed."

units.zh: 每归，妻为具食，不敢于鸿前仰视，举案齐眉。
units.en: Each night his wife served supper without lifting her eyes, raising the tray to her brows in respect.
units.literal: Each time he returned, his wife prepared food and did not dare look up before Hong, raising the tray level with her brows.

units.zh: 咸曰：“要离烈士，而伯鸾清高，可令相近。”
units.en: All agreed: "Yaoli died for honor; Boluan lived in purity—they should lie side by side."
units.literal: All said, "Yaoli was a man of fierce integrity, while Boluan was lofty and pure; it is fitting to let them lie near one another."

units.zh: 及鸿东游思恢，作诗曰：“鸟嘤嘤兮友之期，念高子兮仆怀思，相念恢兮爰集兹。”
units.en: Eastbound, he missed Hui and wrote: "Birds call—friends' season; I long for Gao Zi—my heart dwells here."
units.literal: When Hong roamed east he thought of Hui and composed a poem, saying, "The birds cry softly—the time of friendship; I think of Master Gao—my servant's breast remembers; thinking of Hui—we gather here."
